findings.problem: The example sounds unnatural: the subject pronoun yo adds an emphasis nobody needs here, and insisting fits awkwardly with accepting an offer, so it is a poor model of how the phrase is really used.
findings.fix: example.es: Sí, por favor, quiero un café. / example.en: Yes, please, I want a coffee.

note: Spain also says Sí, por favor, so a null spain field is right.
